description: [Ncloud Storage] Assemble uploaded parts into the final object (POST /{key}?uploadId). Pass every part's partNumber and the ETag returned when it was uploaded; parts are sent in ascending part-number order as the API requires.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

key.description: Object key (path) of the multipart upload target

etag.description: ETag returned by ncloud_ncs_upload_part / upload_part_copy for this part

name: ncloud_ncs_complete_multipart_upload
